caption: The drawing depicts a single sculpted object that resembles a mythological creature, specifically a dragon or griffin. The sculpture features a detailed head with a pronounced snout, pointed ears or horns, and a prominent, curved neck. It has large, feathered wings that extend upwards, and the muscular body is seated in a semi-upright pose with the forelimbs pressed against the chest in a coiled manner. The hind limbs are strong and end in large clawed feet that rest on a rectangular base. The drawing is rendered in monochrome, using shades of gray to depict shadows, highlights, and texture, giving the appearance of a stone or metal statue. The background is plain and light, with no other objects or scenery, focusing all attention on the sculpted figure.
title: Newel Figure
